'''Tamazall''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Zurga Pass]] was in its foothills. The planet was protected by the [[Tamazall Militia]]. [[Prisoner/Legends|Prisoners]] were transported via [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]].
